constants.typeface: No single typeface across the set. The series logo (TORNADOES with of YEAR, red and black T) appears on 4 of 20: 5, 6, 8, 15.
constants.colour_pair: Cream or white text with a black drop shadow on the series titles. Red accent on 8 of 20: 1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 13, 15, 19.
constants.host_placement: When the host is present he sits right of centre (20) or left (12). Clear host face on 2 of 20.
constants.badge: No recurring badge. Watermark PecosHank.com on 1 of 20 (2).
constants.border: No frame border. Black letterbox bars on 2 and 18.
constants.grade: Real photographs or video frames on all 20. No illustrations, maps or satellite images.

channel_findings.host_treatment: Clear host face on 2 of 20 (10%). 12: greyscale cut-out with a white sticker outline, shouting, left, about 11% of frame width, cropped at the bottom edge. 20: natural in frame, head and shoulders, right of centre, about 18% of frame width, no cutout. Partial faces only: 16 (small figure at lower left, not readable) and 17 (dark head shape at top centre). Both clear-face thumbs are in the latest group and have views null. The popular 10 have no face.
channel_findings.text_rules: Text on 13 of 20 (1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 17, 19). Word count 3 is the usual count (6 of 13 text thumbs; range 2 to 6). Caps lead on most (1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13, 15, 17, 19). Mixed case on 14 and on line 2 of 9 and 13. Colours: cream, white, red accent, black shadow. Placement: top third (1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 15, 19) or centre (9, 11, 17). Highlight: one word made larger (5, 7, 13, 14, 19) or in red (1, 7, 13, 19). Text repeats the title on 12 of 13 text thumbs; only 17 adds a new label.
channel_findings.popular_vs_latest: Popular (1 to 10): views 7.7M to 29M. 0 clear host faces. 6 with text (1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9), 4 without (2, 3, 4, 10). Year-series or caps title over 3 panels on 4 (1, 5, 6, 8). Real storm footage on 9 of 10 (10 is an animal). Latest (11 to 20): views 49K to 3.9M, with 3 null (12, 18, 20). 2 clear host faces (12, 20). 7 with text, 3 without (16, 18, 20). Latest uses more text and more graphic title treatments, and carries the only host faces.
channel_findings.top3: 1 (29M, TOP 10 BEST TORNADOES, caps text in a red stamp over 3 panels), 2 (26M, LARGEST TORNADO EVER, no text, wall cloud over a house), 3 (21M, CLOSE TORNADO TEARS THROUGH TOWN, no text, debris over a building). Thumbnail 4 ties 3 at 21M. Shared: real footage only, no host face, one tornado as the subject at scale or at impact, dark or saturated sky, no illustrated background.
transfer: Use real storm footage as the whole background, with no illustrated or map backgrounds. Evidence: 1, 2, 3, 4 are real footage at 21M to 29M; no thumbnail uses a graphic background.
Put a 3-word all-caps title across the top third, in cream or white with a black drop shadow. Evidence: 5, 6, 8 and 15 (TORNADOES of YEAR, 3 words each) at 10M, 10M, 8M and 3.9M.
Use one red accent per thumb: a red stamp, word or numeral. Evidence: 1 (red BEST stamp, 29M), 7 (red SCARIEST, 9.5M), 19 (red FREAKIEST, 884K), 13 (red 4, 1.1M).

State the claim in 3 words or fewer with a number or superlative. Evidence: 1 TOP 10 (29M), 7 SCARIEST (9.5M), 9 GREATEST (7.8M), 11 EVERY TYPE (1.5M), 13 EF4 (1.1M). Keep the title words in the text only if they carry the claim.

Keep the presenter small or in a test. The 2 thumbnails with a clear host face (12, 20) have views null, and the 10 popular thumbnails have no face, so this channel gives no evidence that the face lifts clicks. Test one cut-out inset (12 style) against a no-face version before making the host the hero.

weak.why: GLOWING OCEAN has no storm in frame and adds a new label not in the title; 49K views, the lowest in the set.
No text, low-contrast grey-green frame, the tornado is small against empty sky; nothing to read at phone size; views null.
No text, motion-blurred frame, two animals hard to tell apart; no storm; 7.7M views, so the title likely carries it, not the image.
